title: maba oblongifolia
intro: Maba oblongifolia, commonly known as the Mountain Maba, is a plant species in the family Ebenaceae. It is native to Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The Mountain Maba is known to have anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of the Mountain Maba include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
